facts.title: bean and vegetable burritos
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeño or habanero pepper, minced
2 to 3 teaspoons ground chili powder (to taste)
2 (15.5-ounces) cans black, red, or pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1 1/2 cups corn kernels, fresh (from 2 ears), canned and drained, or frozen (no need to thaw)
8 ounces (about 2 cups) coarsely grated monterey jack or pepper jack cheese
facts.author: Deb Perelman
